snippet.title: Gnomes and Co: The Art of the Build - Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for our upcoming game Gnomes and Co: The Art of the Build

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1253450/Gnomes__Co_The_Art_of_the_Build/

As the newest Director of Operations for Gnomes & Co, your mission is to direct your gnomes to build things as efficiently as possible. The faster the products get built, the more profit we can make!

Although each gnome's move set is simple, every puzzle has a vast array of possible solutions. Compete with other players online to come up with the best designs.
